about: Thompson Law works from Oak Lawn Avenue in Dallas, with a second Dallas office and one in San Antonio, and names 28 attorneys. Its own description is of a national practice reaching Texas, Georgia, Arizona and California, and its headquarters is here.
It publishes a contingency fee, a free consultation, a 24 hour line and pages in Spanish. 2,336 reviews at 4.92, which is the highest average among the firms here with more than a thousand.

json_ld_descriptions: National personal injury lawyers helping clients in Texas, Georgia, Arizona, and California recover compensation for medical bills, lost wages, and pain and suffering. Thompson Law handles serious injury and wrongful death cases with no fee unless we win.

Thompson Law is a personal injury law firm serving clients in Texas, Georgia, Arizona, and California. The firm focuses on helping injury victims recover compensation while providing dedicated legal support and client-focused representation.
